programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We peel back the layers on the Premier League's most iconic managerial rivalries; battles that shaped eras, defined clubs, and captivated fans around the world. From the fierce mind games between Arsene Wenger and Sir Alex Ferguson, to the emotional explosion of Kevin Keegan's title-chasing Newcastle. From the simmering tension and touchline clashes of Mourinho vs. Wenger, to the tactical chess match between Jurgen Klopp and Pep Guardiola.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We explore Arsene Wenger's managerial journey before joining Arsenal, tracing his evolution from a young, innovative coach in France to a transformative force in European football. Delving into his time at Nancy, AS Monaco and Nagoya Grampus Eight, Wenger's tactical brilliance began to shape his future success. We highlight the key moments that led him to one of football's most iconic roles.

programme.title: REVIEW OF THE SEASON - 2024/2025 (LIV)
programme.desc: Relive another extraordinary Premier League campaign as Liverpool soared to an historic 20th league title, Nottingham Forest defied expectations and the promoted sides were strenuously challenged. There were also tactical transformations, shifts in narrative trends, and a more open field than ever before. Review of the Season documents all of the thrilling stories to emerge across the 380 matches.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We dive into the fiercest rivalry in English football-Manchester United and Liverpool. As Liverpool draw level with United's record haul of top-flight titles, this is a story of history, pride, and the relentless pursuit of greatness. With insight from icons on both sides-Ian Rush, Lou Macari, Brian Kidd, Michael Owen, Phil Thompson, and new Liverpool boss Arne Slot, we unpack the moments that have defined generations, split families, and lit up the Premier League.

programme.title: Reims vs Nice - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 17
programme.desc: Reims have lost 26 of their 72 Ligue 1 games against Nice, only losing more against St Etienne. programme.desc: Race 2 of the Trofeo Pirelli class wraps up the weekend at Brno with another high-level contest. Drivers battle for supremacy in identical Ferraris, where consistency, aggression, and precision determine the final outcome.

programme.title: Race 1 - Formula Regional European Championship - Zandvoort Round
programme.desc: The 2025 ADAC GT Masters roars into Zandvoort for Race 1 of the round, with top GT3 teams battling through tight corners and fast straights. With every lap crucial, the fight for early-season momentum delivers thrilling, high-stakes racing on the Dutch circuit.

programme.title: Race 2 - Formula Regional European Championship - Zandvoort Round
programme.desc: Young talents of Formula Regional return to Zandvoort for Race 2, pushing hard through the technical corners in a battle that could shape the future stars of single-seater racing.

programme.title: Qualifying - Aragon GP - Moto GP

programme.title: Sprint Race - Aragon GP - Moto GP

programme.title: DTM Show 2025-Zandvoort
programme.desc: DTM. The embodiment of Motorsport tradition. Having just turned 40, the DTM combines a unique fascination and familiarity with an unmistakable dynamic, signified by the rebranding with a new logo! Seven different manufacturers – ten different winners on six brands (Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Lamborghini, Porsche and Ferrari) through twelve races are but one testament to the unique competitive balance that makes every DTM weekend a revelation! And with the addition of Ford, the palette of different brands is only increasing!

programme.title: DTM 2025 - Zandvoort
programme.desc: DTM. Three letters encapsulating motorsport tradition like few other racing series. Born in 1984, the DTM is coming off one of its strongest ever seasons under the guidance of the ADAC! Nine different race winners from the first nine races – including all six represented brands (Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Lamborghini, Porsche and Ferrari) – an unmistakable testament to the unique competitive balance! Supported by a comprehensive support package including the ADAC GT Masters and ADAC GT4 Germany – the DTM package combines heritage with a powerful drive and a glittering future!

Germany / Italy
programme.desc: Last quarter -final of the Euro Hopes and Titans shock on the program: Germany defies Italy this Sunday at 9:00 p.m. at the Dunajská Streda Mol Arena. Impressive in the group phase, the Mannschaft signed a flawless: Net victories against Slovenia (3-0) and the Czech Republic (4-2), before bringing England (2-1). Led by a sparkling Nick Woltemade (4 goals), left at rest in the last match, Antonio Di Salvo's team is advancing in full confidence. Opposite, Italy has shone with its defensive solidity. Winners of Romania (1-0) and Slovakia (1-0), the Azzurrini then stood up to Spain (1-1) to qualify by finishing second in group A. But the challenge promises to be a completely different caliber in the face of the German attack, the most prolific of the tournament. programme.desc: Sure of his forces after his victory (1-0) against PSG in the Champions League, Bayern Munich wants to continue on his momentum to establish his domination over the Bundesliga against his biggest rival of Borussia Dortmund, 5th, always undefeated at the Iduna Park signal this season. Guided by a kim min-jae in full confidence after her performance size boss against Paris, a joshua kimmich real hub for Munich's midfielder, an extremely impactful Kingsley Coman and a Harry Kane who continues goals with 14 achievements after 11 days, the Bavarians are well armed to win in an always awaited klassiker against marsupial From Jamie Bynoe-Gittens, the Vista of Julian Brandt and the goalscorer of Serhou Guirassy, ​​author of 10 goals since his arrival at the BVB, to bring down the Bavarian ogre and put an end to more than 6 years of scarcity at home.

programme.title: Atlético Madrid / FC Séville
programme.desc: On a small cloud since the end of October with 8 consecutive victories all competitions, Atlético de Madrid, 3rd, must continue on its momentum to stay in the title race against Seville FC, 13th, capable of the best as of the worst this season. Led by an Antoine Griezmann still as efficient with 5 goals on the clock, a Julian Alvarez perfectly suited to the game style of Diego Simeone or even a return jan Oblak at his best level, the Colchoneros have all the cards in hand to win a 5th consecutive Liga victory and stay in contact with Real Madrid and FC Barcelona at the top of the ranking against Andalus Magic of Dodi Lukebakio, author of 6 goals this season, the defensive solidity of Loïc Badé and the talent of Peque Fernández to strike a big blow to the Metropolitano Cívitas and revive in the race for Europe.

programme.title: England / Germany
programme.desc: CLAP FINDING IN APOTOTHEMENT AT THE EURO ESPERS 2025: Germany defies England in the final in Bratislava for electric revenge between two European football giants. Beaten by the Mannschaft in the group phase (2-1), the Young Lions of Lee Carsley have since raised the cursor. Brilliant against Spain (1-3) in quarters, then solid against the Netherlands (2-1), they arrived launched, carried by a sparkling Harvey Elliott: 3 goals and 1 decisive pass in the matches with direct elimination. But Germany impresses even more. Intouchables in hens (9 points), Antonio Di Salvo's men first snatched their place in half against Italy (3-2 A.P.), before offset France (3-0). With 14 goals scored in 5 games, their attack is formidable, led by Nick Woltemade, top scorer of the tournament (6 goals). Between a revengeful England and a Germany in full control, this final promises intensity, talent and fireworks.

programme.title: Florida Panthers / Edmonton Oilers
programme.desc: Night of truth in Sunrise. Back to the amendment Bank Arena with a title ball in hand, Florida only needs a success to keep his Stanley Cup, the second in a row. Untouchables in regulation time since the start of the series, the Panthers have the opportunity to write history in front of their audience. But Edmonton did not say his last word. Beaten by these same panthers in the final last year, the Oilers no longer have the right to make mistakes. Led by a Pressure Connor McDavid, dumb in the last match but already the author of 6 assists in this series, the Canadians will play the excessive attack to snatch a saving game 7. In this battle for survival or glory, every detail will count. Florida wants to conclude, Edmonton wants to survive. An offensive explosion is to be expected, carried by the stars of an evening or a season. The match of all possibilities.

programme.title: Paris-SG / Chambéry
programme.desc: Sacred for the twelfth time in its story after its victory against Istres (39-31), PSG handball is preparing to close its season in apotheosis in Coubertin against Chambéry which remains on a draw of prestige against Nantes (28-28). The opportunity to offer Raul Gonzalez a final ovation in front of his audience. Already titled but still hungry, Parisians will once again be able to count on the solidity of Jannick Green (187 stops), the power of Kamil Syprzak (195 goals, 2nd goalscorer of Starligue) and the Vista of Luc Steins (216 assists), master of playing a roded collective. The goal is clear: celebrate the coronation with the way and close the 2024-2025 exercise on a perfect note. Opposite, Chambéry has nothing to lose and intends to play the spoilsports. The Savoyards will rely on the decisive parades of Valentin Kieffer, the percussion of Sebastien Skube and the abnegation of the duo Arthur Anquetil - Gustavo Rodrigues to try to wave the champion on his land.
